goals: Verify the CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functionalities of the Books API.
Ensure the Books API correctly handles requests for existing and non-existing book resources.
activities: Send a GET request to the /api/books endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Assert the response body is an array.
Send a GET request to the /api/books/1 endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Assert the response body's ID is 1.
Send a GET request to the /api/books/999 endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 404.
Define a new book object with title, author, genre, and copies available.
Send a POST request to the /api/books endpoint with the new book data.
Assert the response status code is 201.
Assert the response body's title is 'Dune'.
Send a PUT request to the /api/books/1 endpoint with updated title data.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Assert the response body's title is 'Updated Title'.
Send a PUT request to the /api/books/999 endpoint with update data.
Assert the response status code is 404.
Send a DELETE request to the /api/books/1 endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 200.
Send a DELETE request to the /api/books/999 endpoint.
Assert the response status code is 404.
